name: Promote Tested Image to Production

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - production
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY: animorhpayrolldev.azurecr.io
  CONTAINER_APP_NAME: ca-dev-payrollv2
  RESOURCE_GROUP: rg-payroll-dev
  STAGE_IMAGE_NAME: payroll-api-stage
  PROD_IMAGE_NAME: payroll-api-prd

jobs:
  promote:
    name: Promote from Stage to Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: production       # triggers manual approval
      url: https://<your-prod-url>  # optional

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Azure Login
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Download last staging image tag
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v3
        with:
          workflow: deploy-stage.yml
          name: image-tag
          path: ./artifact
          branch: stage

      - name: Read image tag
        id: tag
        run: echo "IMAGE_TAG=$(cat ./artifact/image_tag.txt)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Log in to Azure Container Registry
        run: az acr login --name animorhpayrolldev

      - name: Promote image in ACR (tag from stage → prod)
        run: |
          echo "Promoting tag $IMAGE_TAG"
          az acr import \
            --name animorhpayrolldev \
            --source $AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY/$STAGE_IMAGE_NAME:$IMAGE_TAG \
            --image $PROD_IMAGE_NAME:$IMAGE_TAG \
            --force

      - name: Deploy to Azure Container App (PRODUCTION)
        run: |
          az containerapp update \
            --name $CONTAINER_APP_NAME \
            --resource-group $RESOURCE_GROUP \
            --image $AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY/$PROD_IMAGE_NAME:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}

      - name: Output deployment info
        run: echo "🚀 Promoted staging image $IMAGE_TAG to production"
